name: application-expanded-detail-card
title: Expanded Detail Card
description: Dashboard hero-metric card: a large primary metric with a delta badge and comparison caption, followed by a secondary stats grid breaking the metric down further.
useWhen: Anchoring a dashboard section with one primary KPI plus a breakdown of the components that make it up (e.g. new/expansion/churned MRR).
You need more context than a single number and delta — a related-stats grid underneath.
Distinct from Big Number Delta Tile, which is a small single-metric tile with no secondary breakdown, rather than an expanded card meant to anchor a dashboard section.
avoidWhen: You only need a compact single-metric tile with no breakdown — use Big Number Delta Tile instead.
The secondary stats aren't meaningfully related to the primary metric — a plain stat grid may be clearer without a shared hero.
responsiveBehavior: The secondary stats grid stays at three columns since values are short; the hero metric and delta badge stay on one line via items-baseline so their differing font sizes align on the text baseline.
accessibility: The delta direction icon is aria-hidden and paired with a visually hidden "Increased by"/"Decreased by" prefix, so the trend is announced correctly regardless of icon rotation.
Negative secondary stats are marked in red text in addition to their minus sign, never color alone.
Secondary stats use a semantic definition list (dl/dt/dd) for clear label/value association.
